steps.code:
# Filter the list for .pdf files and delete them
pdf_files = [f for f in apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=login_result['access_token'], directory_path='~/downloads', entry_type='files', recursive=True) if f.endswith('.pdf')]

    result = apis.file_system.delete_file(access_token=login_result['access_token'], file_path=pdf_file)
